surface: Existing CLI GET /api/apps/{appID}/secrets metadata; only allowlisted boolean comparisons and key presence retained
conclusion: Both rollout keys and all six Apple IAP configuration keys exist. The read-only metadata response does not expose either rollout flag as a literal boolean value, so enabled versus disabled remains unverified, not known-disabled.
safeSurfaceLimitation: CLI lists names only. The existing App Store handler has prepare, sync_transaction and Apple test-notification diagnostic actions, but no read-only rollout/capability action. checkSubscription may reconcile entitlements and is outside this read-only scope.
